title: Six shortened cyclic fields with accelerated cubes and full-anchor budget retuning

claims.statement: The explicit 6-field degree-167 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-165 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5574898989028330020765184090687/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=292082966244132163504876316750835254026372923355800862824874643169 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(653285/3004).

experiments.purpose: Check QR profiles, field, orbits, work and the first three signed pair cutoffs (0), the remaining seven pair cutoffs (1), child noise shells and the early proper shells (2), and the full occupancy and error remainder (3). Part 0 also checks the faster cube and expanded anchor address allocation; part 2 regenerates 231 child weights with all 166 root budgets.
